purpose: Merge-only Summoning supply modifiers for charm collection, pouch creation and scroll conversion. Exact monster charm rates and live prices are excluded.

activity_additions.name: Familiarisation triple-charm reward
activity_additions.effect: Triples eligible charm drops from monsters while the reward is active.
activity_additions.interaction_order: Applies before the charming potion's flat charm increase.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Treat this as a temporary account buff. Do not multiply elder-charm Nihil production or excluded guaranteed charm sources.

activity_additions.name: Amlodd Voice of Seren Summoning efficiency
activity_additions.category: regional pouch and scroll conversion modifier
examples: A pouch that normally converts to 10 scrolls produces 12.
An Ancient Summoning contract that normally converts to 20 scrolls produces 24.
activity_additions.league_treatment: This is a Tirannwn production advantage, not a prerequisite for using the familiar elsewhere.

equipment_additions.name: Summoning charm-conservation tools

records.name: Spirit gems
records.charge_rule: One charge is consumed whenever a charm is saved.
records.note: Higher-tier gems increase the chance; gems are most valuable on scarce crimson or blue charms.

equipment_additions.league_treatment: Charm-saving effects reduce supply consumption; they do not change familiar unlock requirements or tertiary-item geography.

consumable_additions.name: Charming potion
consumable_additions.effect: Increases the base number of charms dropped by a monster by 1.
consumable_additions.special_charm_rule: Special charms such as abyssal and talon beast charms are affected unless their source has a separate exclusion.
consumable_additions.league_treatment: Apply the flat +1 before temporary League drop multipliers only when the official League rules confirm the stacking order.
